_about: Test questions for the agent. q1-q14 are the project's question list (q15, z1, z2 added 2026-10-21) (q1-q10: places connected to X; q11-q14: the four core types). v1-v13 are variants added to stress the understand step (typos, lower case, off-topic, follow-ups, map conflicts). In a geo_location, coordinates are [lon, lat]. chat_history uses the result shape query() returns.
